title: ci-fix config validator
description: Validates configuration inputs for the ci-fix skill

ci_log.description: Raw CI log output or URL to CI run

ci_run_url.description: URL to the failed CI run (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, etc.)

ci_system.description: CI system in use; auto detects from repo config

failure_type_hint.description: Optional hint about what kind of failure to look for

check_main_status.description: Whether to check if main branch CI is also failing
